[[File:Small rhombidodecacron.stl|thumb|3D model of a small rhombidodecacron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''small rhombidodecacron''' is a nonconvex [[Isohedral figure|isohedral]] [[polyhedron]]. It is the [[Dual polyhedron|dual]] of the [[small rhombidodecahedron]]. It is visually identical to the [[Small dodecacronic hexecontahedron]]. It has 60 intersecting [[antiparallelogram]] faces.

== Proportions==
Each face has two angles of <math>\arccos(\frac{5}{8}+\frac{1}{8}\sqrt{5})\approx 25.242\,832\,961\,52^{\circ}</math> and two angles of <math>\arccos(-\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{5}\sqrt{5})\approx 93.025\,844\,508\,96^{\circ}</math>. The diagonals of each antiparallelogram  intersect at an angle of <math>\arccos(\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{10}\sqrt{5})\approx 61.731\,322\,529\,52^{\circ}</math>. The ratio between the lengths of the long edges and the short ones equals <math>\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{5}</math>, which is the [[golden ratio]]. The [[dihedral angle]] equals <math>\arccos(\frac{-19-8\sqrt{5}}{41})\approx 154.121\,363\,125\,78^{\circ}</math>.
